# PublicViews
**Type:** Measurement instrument  
**Supporting papers:** 1  

## State of the Field

A dataset extracted from TwinViews-13k containing political statements across 31 topics and explicitness variants for evaluating political bias and factuality in generated news.

## Sources

**PublicViews** (1 paper: [Fair or Framed? Political Bias in News Articles Generated by LLMs](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.856.pdf))
